name: Triad — Resonance‑Field Stability Surfaces
summary: Defines the stability surfaces of Triad resonance fields, including resonance‑stability formation, harmonic‑stability locking, ignition‑ready field stabilization, and cross‑layer stability binding.
purpose: Provide the stability‑surface geometry for Triad resonance fields, describing how resonance‑stability surfaces form, lock, stabilize, and bind across Scanner, O.H.S.H.I.T., and Atlas layers to maintain ignition‑ready resonance behavior.
